name.text: Estimating Tangent Slope of Exponential Function

questiontext.text:
The slope of the tangent line to the graph of the exponential function \(y = {@fx@}\) at the point \(( {@point@}, {@y_cord@})\) is \(\displaystyle \lim_{x \to {@point@}} {@df_point_x@}\).

Note: Give the slope in exact form or correct to three decimal places.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

[[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To find the slope of the tangent line to the graph of \(y = {@fx@}\) at the point \(({@point@}, {@y_cord@})\), we need to compute the derivative of \({@fx@}\) at \({@var@} = {@point@}\).

The derivative \(f'(x)\) of a function \(f(x)\) at \(x = a\) is defined as:

\[\displaystyle f'(a) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(a+h) - f(a)}{h} \]

In this case, \( \displaystyle f({@var@}) = {@fx@}\) and \(a = {@point@}\):

\[\displaystyle f'({@point@}) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{{@fxh@} - {@fx@}}{h} = \lim_{h \to 0} {@df_point@} \]

So, \( \displaystyle \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} {@df_point_x@} \) is the derivative of \({@fx@}\) evaluated at \({@var@} = {@point@}\).

This limit represents the slope of the tangent line to the graph of \(y = {@fx@}\) at the point \(({@point@}, {@y_cord@})\).

To find the slope of the tangent line to the graph of \( y = {@fx@} \) at the point \(({@point@}, {@y_cord@})\), we need to compute the limit \(\displaystyle \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} {@df_point_x@}\).

Let's apply L'Hôpital's rule, which is suitable for limits of the indeterminate form \(\displaystyle \frac{0}{0} \):

  1. Evaluate the limit \( \displaystyle \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} {@df_point_x@} \):

    2. This is of the form \(\displaystyle \frac{0}{0} \) as \( {@var@} \to {@point@}\).

  2. Apply L'Hôpital's rule:

    3. \[\displaystyle \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} {@df_point_x@} = \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} \frac{\frac{d}{dx}\left({@num1@}\right)}{\frac{d}{dx}\left({@den1@}\right)} \]

    Compute the derivatives:

    • Derivative of \(\displaystyle {@num1@} \) with respect to \( {@var@} \) is \( {@dnum@} \).
    • Derivative of \(\displaystyle {@den1@} \) with respect to \( {@var@} \) is \( {@dden@} \).

    So, the limit becomes:

    \[ \displaystyle \lim_{{@var@} \to {@point@}} \frac{{@dnum@}}{{@dden@}} = {@ta@} \]

Therefore, the slope of the tangent line to the graph of \(\displaystyle y = {@fx@} \) at the point \(({@point@}, {@y_cord@})\) is \( {@ta@} \).

To estimate this slope to three decimal places:

\[ \displaystyle {@ta@} \approx {@decimalplaces(ta,3)@} \]

So, the slope of the tangent line to \(\displaystyle y = {@fx@} \) at \( {@var@} = {@point@} \) is approximately \( {@decimalplaces(ta,3)@} \).
